deploybot: Deploy requested to prod by @maria — tag v2.14.0 (commit abc1234). Starting canary. CI gate: smoke-tests / integration / lint. Status: running.
ci-gate-bot: CI Gate update — smoke-tests FAILED (job: smoke/sanity-3). Failure summary: service-health-check timeout. Deploy blocked.
maria: Ack. Hold on prod then. @jamal can you take a look at the smoke failure? Is this reproducible on canary?
jamal: Checking logs now. Repro on canary: /health calls timing out at ~30s. Looks like KV-cache warmup spikes p99 on inference-runtime after deploy.
kyle: +1 hold. Suggestion: revert canary to v2.13.8 for safety and open a hotfix branch for v2.14.0. Also try rerun smoke with a slightly higher timeout to rule out flakiness.
jamal: Rerunning smoke with increased timeout: `ci retry smoke/sanity-3 --timeout 45s`
ci-gate-bot: Rerun started (build 8921) for smoke/sanity-3.
ci-gate-bot: Rerun result — FAILED (build 8921). Error: 504 gateway timeout calling inference-runtime/health; stack shows repeated KV cache misses during initial traffic burst.
maria: OK holding prod. @deploybot please pin prod to v2.13.8 and start rollback canary -> stable. Create incident and add release notes team.
deploybot: Rollback initiated by maria. Pinning prod to tag v2.13.8 (commit def9876). Rollback ETA ~3m. Notifying oncall.
jamal: Created INC-2026 with logs and heatmap, assigned to eng-runtime. Adding labels: regression, kv-cache, v2.14.0.
deploybot: Rollback complete. Prod pinned to v2.13.8. CI gate still FAILS for v2.14.0. Next steps: jamal to triage root cause and open hotfix PR; release manager to delay formal release until fix + green CI. :thumbsup:
